_comment: A hired sword (Hires.java): paying one of a town's guards to come with you and fight for you. 'answers': what players type. 'lines': {player} is what it calls you, {pay} its price for a day (or what's still short of it), {when} how long it's still hired for, {who} the one already hired.

hire: i want to hire a guard
ill pay you to come with me
hire_done: i dont need you any more

any: {pay} a day, paid ahead. throw it over and im with you
my sword? {pay} for the day. up front
i can do that. {pay} a day, and i fight in my own gear
{pay} buys you a day of me. more days, more of the same
thats not a days pay. {pay} more
{pay} more and im yours for the day
need {pay} more before i go anywhere
right, im with you {player}. lead on
ok. where you go i go, for {when}
deal. ill watch your back
paid. stay close and ill keep things off you
good, im yours for {when}
ok, {when} then
that keeps me on. {when}
im already yours, for {when}
you hired me already. {when} left on it
still with you. {pay} buys another day when you want one
im no fighter. ask one of the guards
not me, i dont fight for pay. try a guard
you want a guard for that, not me
not for you
i wouldnt go anywhere with you
no. find someone else
someones already paying me
im hired already. ask another guard
cant, im working for someone
youve got {who} already. one of us is enough
arent you paying {who}? one at a time
{who} is with you already. let them go first
not now. the towns got trouble, im needed here
cant leave with things as they are here
ask me when its quiet. im needed
were too few on the walls as it is
cant, theres hardly any of us guarding the place
the town cant spare me right now
{player}? where did you go
lost you {player}. where are you
hey, wait up. i cant see you
{player}! over here
my times nearly up {player}. {pay} for another day
nearly done here. {pay} keeps me on another day
im off home soon unless you pay for more. {pay}
thats my time. im heading home
days done. good luck out there {player}
thats what you paid for. im off
ok. im heading home then
right. take care of yourself
fine by me. see you around
thats one of ours! were done
you dont touch my people. were finished
no. not them. keep your money, im gone
youre wanted back home. were done
